title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 28: Communication in the future (Set 1)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Communication in the future (Set 1) ngay nhé!

(Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập.)

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Communication in the future (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Read the passage and choose the correct option that best fits each of the blanks. Communication is faster and easier for everyone. People do not need to wait long for messages because they are sent 15.1 late instantly leisurely slowly . New technology helps people share their ideas in different ways. People can use 15.2 thoughts emojis recipes ideas to show their emotions more clearly in messages. Instead of typing long texts, they send a(n) 15.3 voice message email textbook warning  to speak directly. Also, the Internet 15.4 fight evidence tradition connection is stronger everywhere, so people can talk from any place in the world without problems. Social media continues to grow, and everyone has a(n) 15.5 account habit code vehicle to stay connected. They use it to chat, share pictures, and join online events. In the future, people will communicate in ways we cannot imagine today. It will be exciting to see how technology changes the way we talk to each other!
